x: Although the Sheffield boys were busy with their own race in Sheffield, J. Proctor made the journey to London to walk as an individual, and right well did he upset all the sages by walking extremely fast in the early stages and maintaining practically the same speed throughout, eventually returning…
The start was a fairly fast one with Proctor, Lloyd Johnson, Martineau and Clayton well up in the lead. Proctor soon went away taking advantage of the home ground and knowing the course well.

Our lesser hopes in the 50kms walk were confirmed although Alf Cotton and John Proctor walked well to finish 5th and 6th. The superiority of the Russian women in the power events was early established by Nina Doumbadze in the women's discus, winning by some six metres from her nearest rival.
